data_split.anchor: frozen study end-exclusive date; normally start of today UTC, through yesterday

development.selection_target: stable parameter plateau, not maximum backtest return

live_monitoring.kill_switch: WATCH = p95 of the 63-trading-day day-block-bootstrap drawdown/losing streak; KILL = max(p99, worst 63-day window in evidence)

three_way_monte_carlo.input: per-trade net results of the frozen final version in close-time order, in R (net / initial stop risk) or money

reshuffle.sizing_rule: plan drawdown = max(real drawdown, reshuffle p95 drawdown)

resample.report: red %, total and drawdown p05/p50/p95 for both horizons

randomize.extra_cost_note: declared assumption, uniform [0, 2 x mean] per trade, ON TOP of the recorded costs; replace with measured broker cost when available
randomize.report: both / drop-only / cost-only red %, plus a cost ladder 0.02 / 0.05 / 0.10 / 0.20 R and the break-even extra cost

applies_to: every new EA idea: stage 3, stage 4 and stage 6
buy_hold_benchmark.not_yet_applied_to: EAs built before 2026-11-05; the owner will revisit them separately
buy_hold_benchmark.method: native Model 4 on the same asset, windows and deposit, one long position at 1x notional, held to the end of the window, real spread / commission / swap
buy_hold_benchmark.gate: required comparison, not an automatic reject; the owner decides

random_entry_control.source: owner request (QuantLab research library: every idea vs random entries with the same times, stops and costs)
random_entry_control.method: each copy keeps every real trade direction, clock time of day, stop distance, target distance and holding time; entry on a random trading day of the same bar history; stop first when stop and target share a bar; same average cost in R charged
random_entry_control.gate_note: lenient on purpose: removes market drift (an index that rose for years makes any long rule look good); it does not prove an edge. Keep the existing random-direction controls as well.

cost_stress.cost_definition: per-trade recorded spread + commission + swap in R (spread = entry spread price distance / initial stop distance; use measured broker spreads, never invented ones)

walk_forward.where: inside the pre-OOS history only (development + validation); the fixed last-two-year OOS is still evaluated once afterwards
walk_forward.selection: best plateau score = mean t-value of the setting and its one-step neighbours, minimum 30 training trades
walk_forward.blind_method: same selection on scrambled training scores (per fold)
report: chained test trades / total / mean R / t-value
real vs blind t-value and total percentiles
walk_forward.note: complements, does not replace, the 5.3 staged search and the validation pick
